description:
Test build. v1.3.0 candidate: selftext inline images + Reddit video player links.

rc3: video player links now open in rif's native ExoPlayer (via MainActivity), using rif's working /api/info.json metadata path. Replaces the rc1 (post permalink) and rc2 (v.redd.it rewrite) approaches, both of which hit rif loaders that fail without post context.
